# Steelman First

<p class="lens-meta"><code class="lens-code">STEELMAN</code> · Modern — analytic and scientific method · <strong>Catalogued — a reading, owns no gate</strong></p>

## The failure it names

attacking a position its holder would not recognise

## What it does

a `contradicts` edge requires a steelman the opponent would accept

## Worked example

State the opposing case so well that its holder thanks you, before saying a word against it.

## Sources

- Daniel Dennett, Intuition Pumps and Other Tools for Thinking (2013), ch. 3
- Anatol Rapoport, Fights, Games and Debates (1960)
